artworks.title: Count Gondamor
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man facing slightly to his right. He has a receding hairline, short hair, a pointed beard, a strong nose, and deep-set eyes. He wears a high-collared garment with a decorative ruff and a chain necklace with a circular medallion. The portrait is framed by an oval line on a textured background. Text at the bottom of the image provides additional information.

artworks.title: Charles de Gontaut, Duc de Biron
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man, Charles de Gontaut, Mareschal de France, within an oval frame. He has curly hair, a styled mustache, and a pointed beard. He wears period clothing with a high lace collar and armor with patterns, suggesting nobility. His expression is serious and he looks directly at the viewer. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Aloisius Gonzaga, Marquess of Mantua
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in profile facing left. The man has distinct facial features, a long beard, and wears a head covering. He is dressed in a tunic with a high collar. The image is framed by an ornate oval border with text including "GONZAGA" and "CAP. MANTVAE ET REGI." Below the oval is a decorative emblem resembling a coat of arms. The composition features intricate scrolling patterns and fine cross-hatched lines typical of engraving. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Carolus Gonzaga, Duc de Nevers-Rethel
artworks.description: This image shows a bust-length engraving of a man centered within an oval frame. The man is positioned facing slightly towards the right, with direct eye contact with the viewer. His facial features include a prominent nose, full cheeks, and a short, well-kept beard and mustache, while his hair is styled in loose curls around his head. He is depicted wearing an ornate outfit typical of nobility, including a high, broad lace collar, a richly embroidered garment embellished with pearls, and a draped sash over one shoulder. Around his neck hangs a delicate chain. The border contains detailed engravings of armor, helmets, and weapons. The background consists of the decorative oval border itself, which contains text identifying the subject as Carolus Gonzaga and marking his titles. Below the portrait, there are further inscriptions and text likely attributing authorship or describing the subject.

artworks.title: Charles de Gonzaga and Cleves, Duke of Mantua
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a young man dressed in a 17th-century-style garment. He has curly hair, distinct facial features, and is posed formally. He holds an object in his left hand and is surrounded by an oval frame with engravings, including his name and titles. The background is detailed with fine lines and shading, typical of engravings from this period.

artworks.title: Charles de Gonzaga and Cleves, Duke of Mantua
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a young man from the waist up. He is standing in a slightly turned position, with one hand on his hip and the other holding a sword hilt. His facial features include high cheekbones, a defined jawline, and expressive eyes. His hair is styled in curls that reach his shoulders. He wears an ornate jacket with puffed sleeves and a collared shirt. The background features a decorative oval frame with text indicating his name and titles, as well as additional text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Ferdinand Gonzaga
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a person in profile view, facing to the right. The individual's upper body, from head to shoulders, is portrayed with distinct facial features including a prominent nose, full beard, and mustache. The person's hair is styled back, revealing a receding hairline. They wear a high-collared ruff and clothing that resembles formal or military attire, possibly armor. The background features a dark, cross-hatched oval within a rectangular frame, with inscriptions identifying the person as Ferdinandus Gonzaga.

artworks.title: Lady Jane Gray
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up, centered within an ornate circular frame. She is positioned facing forward with her head turned slightly to her left. Her facial features are delicately carved with a smooth forehead, almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and closed lips. Her hair appears to be parted in the middle and gathered under a decorative cap or headpiece adorned with jewels or embroidery. She wears a richly detailed gown, featuring intricate patterns, and a bodice accented with ornate designs and embroidered details. Around her neck is a beaded necklace with a large pendant hanging at the center. The background includes a draped fabric setting, with a glimpse of a cloudy sky and landscape to her left. The entire composition is framed within an arch, and beneath is the inscription "JANA GRAYA" along with the artist's signature.

artworks.title: Lady Jane Gray
artworks.description: An engraved portrait of a person is shown from the bust up. The figure faces slightly to the left with facial features delicately rendered, including prominent eyes and smooth contours. Their hair is styled neatly and covered with an elaborate headdress adorned with jewels or decorative elements. The person wears intricately patterned clothing with a high neckline, ornate sleeves, and a necklace with a large pendant. In the background, a draped curtain and a partial view of a landscape add depth to the image. The portrait is encased in an ornamental oval frame.

artworks.title: Lady Jane Grey
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The engraving shows a woman from the waist up, facing forward with her head slightly turned to her right. She has delicate features, slender eyebrows, large eyes, and a small mouth. Her hair is styled back and covered with an ornate headpiece. She wears a detailed dress with a square neckline, long sleeves, and intricate designs. She also wears a necklace with a pendant and another pendant on her chest. The background is made up of fine lines and hatched texture with a caption at the bottom reading "IANA GRAYA" along with additional text below it.

artworks.title: Lady Jane Grey
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a portrait of a person from mid-torso up. The subject has delicate facial features, with a petite nose and softly rounded cheeks, and they are gazing directly at the viewer. The hair is styled neatly under a headpiece adorned with woven designs. The person is wearing an ornate garment with patterns and embroidery, a choker-style necklace, and a pendant. The background is textured, and below the portrait is a label with the inscription "IANA GRAYA" and additional text. The engraving is on beige paper with a border.

artworks.title: Joanna Gray (Lady Jane Grey)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a woman. The woman has a solemn expression with large eyes, a straight nose, and slightly parted lips. Her hair is styled back and covered with a headpiece adorned with delicate patterns. She is depicted wearing a richly decorated dress with intricate designs and embellishments, and a high neckline adorned with a necklace. There is a prominent brooch or pendant at her chest. The background consists of a patterned oval border, with linework suggesting an ornate frame enclosing the portrait. The engraving is labeled at the bottom with the name "Ioanna Gray" along with additional text in a script.

artworks.title: Lady Dudley, Lady Jane Grey
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a person from the waist up, in a seated or standing profile position facing the viewer's left. The person has finely detailed facial features, including a feminine nose and lips. Their hair is styled in an updo, covered by a patterned net or cap, with a small cap on top. They wear a long-sleeved dress with puffed shoulders, a fitted bodice, a large brooch at the neckline, and a visible chain. An earring is noticeable. The background features an ornate oval frame with decorative elements, and below it, a banner with the inscription "Johanna Graia Angliae Regina Coronata."

artworks.title: Sir Richard Grenville, Naval Commander
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a bust portrait identified as Richard Grenville. The person faces forward with his head slightly turned to the left, looking at the viewer. He has a high forehead, prominent nose, a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, and medium-length hair brushed back. He wears a collared garment with decorative details. The background features vertical lines in an oval shape with an inscription. The image has a formal and historical appearance on a plain paper surface.

artworks.title: Sir Richard Grenville, Naval Commander
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with distinguished facial features. He is positioned with his body facing slightly to the left and his head turned forward. The man has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full beard and mustache. His medium-length hair is white. He is dressed in a detailed garment with a ruffled white collar and a textured cloak or robe. The portrait is in an oval frame with stylized text below it, all on a textured, sepia-toned page with faint text in the background.

artworks.title: Sir Richard Grenville, Naval Commander
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This is an engraving showing an upper-body portrait of a man facing slightly to his right. The man has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, with a prominent nose and light-colored hair. He is wearing a detailed garment with a high collar, covered by a fur-lined cloak, and a lace collar around his neck. The oval frame surrounding the portrait includes the inscription "RICHARDVS GRENVILVS" and some Latin text at the bottom. The background has a crosshatched pattern for depth, and there is a textured border outside the oval frame.

artworks.title: Thomae Gresham Equi. Aura (Sir Thomas Gresham)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man, displaying his upper half, seated upright. The man has a long, pointed beard and mustache, with short hair visible beneath a flat, beret-like hat. He is dressed in richly decorated garments, featuring ornate patterns and textures, and holds a pair of gloves in his left hand, with a sword hanging from his waist. His right hand rests on his hip. Around his neck, he wears a frilled collar, and on his left ear is a large earring. The background includes elaborate scrollwork with two cherubs holding a wreath above his head, and Latin inscriptions are woven into the design, identifying this as an image of Thomas Gresham. The portrait is enclosed within an oval frame, with decorative elements and small shields appearing in the corners of the engraved border.

artworks.title: Thomae Gresham Equi. Aura (Sir Thomas Gresham)
artworks.description: The image is a half-length portrait of a man standing within an ornate oval frame. He is facing the viewer with a calm expression, sporting a pointed beard, mustache, and a cap. He wears a patterned tunic with a high collar, a fur-lined cloak, and holds a sword or staff decorated with intricate designs. Two cherubs with a floral garland flank him, and Latin text encircles him within the frame. The background has fine hatch work, adding texture to the portrait.

artworks.title: Edmund Grindal, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of an older man from the waist up. The man has deep-set eyes, a long white beard, a mustache, and a high forehead. He wears a dark robe with a high, stiff collar and a dark cap. The background has textured surfaces with horizontal lines, and at the bottom are inscriptions with the name "EDMVNDVS GRINDALVS," Latin text, and a mark.

artworks.title: Hugo Grotius
artworks.description: The image depicts a young boy from the waist up, seated and facing slightly to the right. His body is turned towards the viewer, and his head is slightly tilted. The boy has a round face, straight bangs, and short, closely cropped hair. His facial features are delicate and youthful. He is dressed in a detailed coat with puffed sleeves and a high, frilled collar. The fabric of the clothing has intricate patterns and decorative elements. He is wearing a long chain necklace with a large, circular medallion that he is holding up with his right hand. The background is a plain, shaded oval. The edges of the image feature inscriptions in Latin.

artworks.title: Hugo Grotius
artworks.artist: Johannes van Munnickhuysen after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man within an intricately etched oval frame adorned with floral patterns. The man has a mustache, a small goatee, curly hair styled back, and wears a dark formal garment with a white collar. The background is dark, and below the portrait is an inscription identifying the man as Hugo Grotius, along with additional biographical information and texts in Latin. The portrait is rendered in a classical etching style with precise lines and shading.

artworks.title: Hugo Grotius
artworks.artist: Abraham Meindersz van der Wenne after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: This image shows the upper half of a man facing forward with his body slightly turned to the right. The man has wavy hair, a full mustache, and a small goatee. He wears clothing typical of the 17th century, including a dark garment with a white ruff collar. The background features an oval frame with leaf-like designs and closely placed parallel lines. Below the portrait is a panel of text.

artworks.title: Abraham Gorlaeus
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man seated and looking directly at the viewer. He has short, curly hair, a mustache, and a contemplative expression. The man wears formal attire with a ruffled collar and his hands rest on a table with coins and tools. A coat of arms is on the wall to his right. The background features intricate woodwork or stonework, bookshelves, architectural elements, and a partially visible female statue.

artworks.title: Hugo Grotius
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man with a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, short combed-back hair, and a garment with a high ruffled collar and buttons. The engraving is framed by ornate scroll designs and inscribed names, with a shaded background.
